full_judgment: 6. PW 5 Omar Siddique is the uncle and father-in-law of PW 2 Safura Khatun, he is also related to the accused-persons. He heard about the occurrence from PW 2 Safura Khatun that the appellant dealt 3 (three) Ramdao blows on the neck of the deceased Barn Haji, In cross-examination this common relation of both the parties admitted that in 1978 the accused-persons obtained a kabala in respect of the disputed land by practicing fraud upon Safura Khatun. He also admitted that he borga cultivated the land under PW 2 Safura Khatun by executing a registered kabuliyat on 25-11-80. He denied the defence suggestion that he along with Barn Haji and others attacked the accused persons while they were cutting paddy and chased them upto the house of the accused-persons and set fire in their house. This witness admitted that he is an accused in the counter case. PW 6 Shahar Ali and PW 7 Abdul Quddus were tendered by the prosecution and defence declain to cross-examine them. PW 8 Sub- inspector, Afzal Hossain recorded the FIR Exhibit 3 PW 9 SI Rakibuddin investigated into this case and submitted charge-sheet The Investigating Officer stated in the cross-examination that PW 2 Safura Khatun stated to him that prior to the occurrence the accused-persons protested against cutting of paddy in the disputed land by the deceased and his party men. The Investigating Officer also stated that PW 4 Sukur Ahamed, PW 5 Omar Siddique also made similar statements to him.
